notes: Exalted: The Abyssals reviewed cover-to-cover for player-facing mechanics (Chapters One through Six), plus the supplements The Book of Bone and Ebony and Savant and Sorcerer (with Book of Three Circles consulted only to resolve the Solar Circle Sorcery access question), plus the cross-splat Exalted Players Guide's universal Merits/Flaws chapter, plus two small sets of universal artifact catalog rows: 6 rows derived from Lunar's verified transcription of the Exalted Storyteller's Companion's 'Further Wonders' chapter, and 9 rows freshly transcribed from Savage Seas' 'Artifacts of the Waves' section (8 selectable, 1 reference-only -- Armor of Aquatic Puissance, which the source text explicitly states no Abyssal owns). 684 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/abyssal/inventory/. Core book (287 rows): the character-creation overview, the universal Anima Effect, all five Castes, the Abyssal Curse, the Virtues of Death, the full Resonance mechanic (gain/loss/manipulation), the-title, Useful Crafts, the Cult exclusion sidebar, the six new deathknight-only Backgrounds, the altered Backgrounds, all 228 Chapter Five Charm rows covering every Ability line for all five Castes, the complete 26-spell necromancy system across all three circles (Shadowlands 9, Labyrinth 9, Void 8), 4 of 5 Crafts of the Dead, and a confirmed absence of Abyssal-specific Merits/Flaws in the core book itself. The corpus-rending-blow prerequisite gap was resolved, unblocking ghost-warding-glyph. Book of Bone and Ebony supplement (177 rows): 80 new necromancy spells, a 69-entry artifact catalog (Wonders of the Dead), 5 named artifacts plus 1 embedded spell from the Creations of Bone chapter, an excluded finding for its Arts of the Dead chapter (ghost Arcanoi, not player Charms), and the chapter's remaining nemissary-crafting/war-machine-construction subsystem plus Armies of the Dead troop-logistics material (24 rows: 5 selectable, 13 reference-only, 5 gm-only, 1 excluded) -- this book is now fully triaged with no remaining resume points. Savant and Sorcerer supplement (125 rows): the complete Chapter Five Terrestrial/Celestial Circle spell catalog (84 selectable spells) plus its own Solar Circle/Circle of Adamant spells (9, marked reference-only since no Abyssal-accessible enabling Charm exists), the 15-entry Sample Hearthstones catalog plus its formation/Theme/Expression framework, 5 Sample Artifacts plus the artifact-creation framework, the Warstriders appendix (framework, all 5 classes including the Abyssal-flavored Royal/soulsteel and Juggernaut/deathknight variants, the Proteus Gauntlet, and a weapon-table summary), and excluded/gm-only findings for Chapter One (Magical Theory, pure lore) and Chapter Four (Practical Summonings, GM-facing demon/elemental summoning framework). Abyssal Solar Circle Sorcery access was investigated via Book of Three Circles Chapter Four and confirmed NOT granted to player characters: its intro sidebar only claims the Abyssal Exalted 'have recently demonstrated the ability' as flavor text, with no enabling Charm or rule anywhere in either book. Exalted Players Guide supplement (80 rows: 40 merits + 40 flaws): derived from Lunar's already-verified transcription of that universal chapter's full 88 pg-merit-*/pg-flaw-* rows rather than an independent re-read, filling the confirmed Merits/Flaws gap noted above; 8 of the 88 were skipped as inapplicable to a deathknight Exalt (Prodigy, Terrestrial Bloodline, Past Lives, Legendary Breeding, Limited Forms, Chimera, Known Anathema, Greater Curse), and several included rows carry genuinely Abyssal-specific text from the source (Taint's Warning, Eternal Vow, Death-Taint, Priest, Destiny, Dark Fate, Sun-Seared, Pain Tolerance, Disfigured, Permanent Caste Mark, Throwback, Damaged Artifact) -- see source-manifest.json and the abyssal README for the full derivation writeup. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. A handful of Chapter Five rows still need a dedicated tree-topology disambiguation pass, two Chapter Five rows and two supplement spell rows (brick-by-brick-solitude, barred-tomb, marked unresolved for missing mote costs) need follow-up before promotion (see source-manifest.json rulesNotes). Chapter Six's ghost/NPC Arcanoi trees, Chapter Seven's Storytelling material, and the Blood and Salt supplement remain out of scope/untriaged. Locked pending remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families. A final cross-splat supplement-triage pass added 16 rows (684 -> 700) from Exalted: Blood and Salt: a Lintha-connection Character Backgrounds reinterpretation sidebar, a Bluehaven approach-navigation rule, four regional Character Concepts lists, seven new Artifacts (including the Talisman of the Cult of Dukantha, which grants Infernal sorcery access), one new Hearthstone (Jewel of Stability), three mundane equipment items, and two new Terrestrial Circle spells (Song of the Lintha, Water's Ally); the rest of the book's NPC/monster stat-block material was reviewed and confirmed out of scope, and four reprinted artifacts (plus, where applicable, a reprinted Hearthstone and two reprinted/superseded spells) received citation notes on their existing rows rather than new duplicate rows.
